posts.name: Fynikz
posts.cooked:
I was quite surprised to see that all of the Freedom Five (along with some of the other heroes and villains) have new costumes in the RPG. Epsecially since with the Freedom Five variant cards being released recently (ish), I expected the F5 to be dressed in those.

What're everyone's thoughts on the new costumes? Favorites/least?

I personally love Absolute Zero's new costume the best just on pure style compared to his old ones, and Bunker is also pretty high up on my list. Maybe I just like power armor too much. Bunker's look is REALLY divergent from how he was before, but his suits all look pretty different from each other, and it's got a very heroic "shining armor" look to it.

My least favorite is probably the new version of Anubis. He's got somewhat of a mummy/death vibe to him which I dig, but I honestly couldn't tell who he was supposed to be when I saw the art without a label. The lack of any sort of jackal motif is kind of weird. I thought Anubis had a real jackal head and not even a costume in the original card from the Tomb, similar to how Tefnut, Geb, Isis, and Shu all have extreme physical mutations.

(Flagged mild spoilers since some folks might not even want to know what heroes/villains show up, even if they don't know what they're doing or why)

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: The Anubis in SotM is the original Anubis and not someone who gained the powers through a relic of power.   This is the first time someone is Anubis using a relic of power so it’s hard to say whether it should transform him that much or not but I liked it.  The Freedom Five outfits I think all look good and we had a preview from Adam a bit ago for his swaptober art.   I really like the new Haka.   Tempest’s outfit just seems odd to me.   I don’t like or dislike it but it stands out to me.

posts.cooked:
I love Baron Blade's new look for basically being peak aristocratic mad scientist.

I like how Argent seems to have pretty much fully embraced the "bard" part of his look, though I do wonder what we should read into the rose taped around his arm.

Visionary looks really sharp, too. Like the sort of outfit she can finally be at home in.

Out of the F5's new looks, I think I like Tachyon's the best, especially those sweet goggles and boss running shoes.

On the flipside, I agree that Tempest's new look is just... odd-looking.

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
Yeah, Tempest has a distinct Chippendales look to them.  I agree that Anubis's look is an odd decision--the Ennead has several members that outright have animal heads, so that should be acceptable.  I guess he doesn't just because he's a hero now and the jackal head doesn't look even remotely heroic.  Haka looks cool but doesn't look at all Maori--she has a sort of Celtic/Native American thing going on.

On the other hand, AA looks fantastic (and makes me wonder if one could use the Sentinels rules to run a straight-up fantasy game).  I like the new Wraith (no more bandage-mask) and Bunker (shiny!), but for AZ and Tachyon I'm spoiled by their gender-swapped versions, which look great.

I kind of hope Adam redoes the cover of Sentinels of Freedom #1, though.  The angle young Legacy is flying at and those thigh-boots make her look like an amputee.  And Heritage... he looks like a court jester.  What are the emblems on his shoulders supposed to be?  They look like ouija pendulums.
